contributions.detail: 7 itemised income rows sum to EXACTLY 2,166.58 = cover line 1 CUMULATIVE. The rows are cycle-cumulative and the split is provable inside the ledger itself: the first SIX rows sum to 1,075.00 = cover line 1 LAST REPORT, and the seventh (12/5/16 Kevin & Teri Rhodes, 1,091.58) is exactly cover line 1 THIS REPORT. The cover identity closes to the cent: 1,075.00 + 1,091.58 = 2,166.58. RECONCILED AGAINST LINE 1 ONLY, per the sub-$50 rule: the ledger separately prints 'Aggregate of Contributions, $50 or less  $290.00', which equals cover line 2 CUMULATIVE and is NEVER itemised - it is not a row and is not transcribed. The ledger's own schedule_total for the Income column, $2,456.58, is the sum of the itemised 2,166.58 PLUS that 290.00 aggregate, so it is a DIFFERENT SCOPE from the itemised rows and is recorded here rather than scored against.

expenditures.detail: 16 itemised expense entries net to EXACTLY 2,456.58, which equals BOTH cover line 3 CUMULATIVE (2,456.58) and the ledger's own printed Totals row (-$2,456.58). The netting requires SUBTRACTING the 10/21/16 refund of 751.00 (see that row's note); no other reading closes. The rows are cycle-cumulative and the split is again provable inside the ledger: the first THIRTEEN entries sum to 2,100.88 = cover line 3 LAST REPORT, and the last three (56.70 + 1,050.00 - 751.00) sum to 355.70 = cover line 3 THIS REPORT. Cover identity: 2,100.88 + 355.70 = 2,456.58, exact.

gates.page_subtotal: p3 income rows 2,166.58 = cover line 1 CUM 2,166.58 (and 1,075.00 / 1,091.58 against the LAST and THIS cells); p3 expense entries net 2,456.58 = cover line 3 CUM 2,456.58 = the ledger's printed Totals -$2,456.58 (and 2,100.88 / 355.70 against the LAST and THIS cells). The ledger's Income Totals cell of $2,456.58 is NOT a gate for the itemised rows - it includes the un-itemised $290.00 sub-$50 aggregate.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py does not apply - p3 is an unruled typed sheet, not a ruled grid. Independent check instead: an ink-projection of p3 at 200 dpi over each column band returns 22 Date/Name text lines between the header and the 'Aggregate' line, 7 Income entries, and 16 Expense entries (23 money entries over 22 rows). Every money entry maps to exactly one Date/Name row and every row receives at least one, with the single double-entry row being 9/30/16 Robin Deissinger, which carries an offsetting $75.00 income and -$75.00 expense. 7 + 16 rows emitted; no entry unassigned, none duplicated.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 crop at the first contribution row renders '4/16/16 Cache Dems | 550 N Main St #302, Logan, UT 84321 | $500.00' together in one band; the crop at the last renders '12/5/16 Kevin & Teri Rhodes | 161 E 100 S, Newton, UT 84327 | $1,091.58'; the control one row-pitch below the last renders the 'Aggregate of Contributions, $50 or less  $290.00' line, which is correctly NOT emitted as a row. On the expenditure side the first-entry crop renders '3/11/16 Cache County--candidacy filing ... -$112.50' and the last renders '10/21/16 Cache Valley Media Group--radio spot: refund for overcharge ... $751.00'. Money-cell x-extents were measured from the ink (income x_200 1157-1257, expense x_200 1286-1395) after a first crop attempt at an eyeballed x missed the column.
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY AT EVERY COLUMN, which is the strongest chain in this chunk. LAST: contributions 1,075.00 + 250.00 aggregate = 1,325.00, minus expenses 2,100.88 = -775.88 = the printed line-4 LAST cell (written WITH its minus sign - this filer got the sign right). THIS: 1,091.58 + 40.00 - 355.70 = 775.88 = the printed line-4 THIS cell. CUM: 2,166.58 + 290.00 - 2,456.58 = 0.00 = the printed 0.0, which the ledger's own Balance column independently prints as $0.00. LAST + THIS = CUM holds on all four lines. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so the cross-filing LAST-column chain could not be run here - but the ledger is cumulative and internally reproduces the LAST-column figures, which is the same check by another route.

escalation_note: 600 dpi crops: the cover's four-line anchor block; two half-page crops of the typed ledger; per-row band crops at the first and last contribution rows and the first and last expense entries; a control crop one pitch below the last contribution row; plus tight column crops after an ink-projection was used to locate the money columns exactly. NO glyph was 'settled' by resolution - the ledger's own Totals row and the cover's LAST/THIS/CUM identities decided every figure, per the Rhodes rule that arithmetic outranks any re-read.
notes: THIS IS THE RHODES FILER NAMED IN THE CACHE ADDENDUM, and the calibration lesson applied cleanly: nothing here needed a bistable-glyph ruling because the document's arithmetic is fully self-proving in three independent places (cover LAST+THIS=CUM on all four lines, the ledger's own Totals row, and the running subtotals that reproduce the LAST-column figures at exactly the right row). Chunk file says candidate 'Kevin Rhodes', office 'County Council'. The cover reads 'Full Name of Candidate: KEVIN L. RHODES' and 'Name of Office: CACHE COUNTY COUNCIL' / 'Office District: NORTH' / 'Political Party: DEMOCRAT'. AGREES; county office, in scope. Form date '6 DEC 2016'; chunk file says 2016-12-08, which is the county's index date and NOT the date on the form - the FORM governs; clerk stamp CLERK REC'D DEC 8 '13:56. DOCUMENT SHAPE: page 2 is the printed Form A and it is ENTIRELY BLANK; the itemisation for BOTH sides lives on page 3, a typed 'Finance Report for Kevin Rhodes' sheet with columns Date / Name / Address / Income / Expense / Balance, filed under the Carr form's own instruction to 'use blank paper and list information like the above format'. Page 4 is blank. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN (the thing that could have wrecked this document): the money columns are printed roughly HALF A LINE HIGHER than the Date/Name column throughout - the Income/Expense/Balance HEADERS are offset by the same amount, which proves the offset is a property of the print (a spreadsheet column vertical-alignment difference), not of the data. Assigning each money entry to the Date/Name row about 20 px BELOW it is the only coherent mapping: it puts the $112.50 candidacy filing fee on the Cache County row, puts every Income entry on a row that also carries a donor ADDRESS, and consumes all 23 entries across 22 rows. The alternative offset would have to hand the first expense to the header row. Every donor's full street address and ZIP is printed in the clear on this ledger, as are the candidate's own address, both phone numbers and the address of his self-funding row; only city and state were kept.
